import sys

import firebase_admin
firebase_admin._apps = {"[DEFAULT]": True}

from app.routers.jobs import router
from app.core.dependencies import verify_cron_secret

# Verify cron secret protection via dependant graph
for r in router.routes:
    all_deps = []
    def collect_deps\(dependant\):
        for d in dependant.dependencies:
            all_deps.append\(d.call\)
            collect_deps\(d\)
    collect_deps\(r.dependant\)
    assert verify_cron_secret in all_deps, f"{r.path} missing verify_cron_secret. Found: {all_deps}"

assert "jobs_router" in src and "app.include_router\(jobs_router\)" in src
print\("✅ main.py registration OK"\)

all_routes = [r for r in app.routes if hasattr\(r, 'methods'\)]
print\(f"\\nTotal API routes registered: {len\(all_routes\)}"\)
for r in all_routes:
    print\(f"  {sorted\(r.methods\)} {r.path}"\)
